exact_answers.identity: Before You Place an Order / A. Sizing / 2. Will I receive a two sizes larger item?
exact_answers.new_English_meaning: Size labels and measurements vary by product and manufacturer. Choose each item using its product-specific size chart and the available options, rather than assuming your usual letter size or applying a fixed size conversion. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering.
